description: Turn complex project schedules into a clear, executive-ready timeline. The Insightlytics Gantt Chart is a professional Power BI visual built to plan, track, and communicate multi-project portfolios with precision and visual impact. KEY CAPABILITIES • Multi-project view — each project with its own title bar, phase zones, and status line on a shared time axis. • WBS hierarchy — parent/child tasks with automatic EDT numbering and expand/collapse. • Phases — dynamic, color-coded zones from each phase's earliest start and latest end. • Dependencies & milestones — links between activities and configurable milestone symbols. • Reference (status) line — a today/report-date line drawn per project. • Smart time header — up to three levels, minimum column width, and full weekend handling. • Planned & baseline bars — compare actual vs. planned at a glance. • Status & priority icons — map data values to shapes and letters. INTERACTIVITY • Selection and cross-filtering across your report. • Subtree selection — click a parent to select all descendants (great for rolling up cost/effort). • Drill-through and native report-page tooltips. BUILT FOR THE ENTERPRISE Complete High Contrast support and Microsoft AppSource security standards, with extensive formatting. Start today with a free 15-day trial.
